tiles.name: The Drain
tiles.note: Where everyone arrives: the hatch overhead, a ladder down, tanks in the corners. Lit — the first safe room.

tiles.name: The Valve Gallery
tiles.note: The end of the level: two rows of valve stations, then a clear antechamber with the pressure door and the fuse panel in the end wall. Every lamp works.
A gallery with its pipe manifolds racked along one wall.
Wider bays either side of the run: pipe manifolds north, breakers south.
Four galleries meet round four concrete piers.
Offices and the foreman north, the crew's break room at the end; lockers, toilets and showers south. One corridor through it.
Records, offices and the supervisor either side of a corridor, with a control room and its switch room across from each other.
The crew's mess: two long tables, the serving counter along the back. Lit — a safe room.
A small break room: two tables, a counter and a cupboard. Lit — safe.
Where the tunnel crews eat: a table, a counter, shelves by the door. Lit — safe.
A wall of consoles, desks in front of it, breakers either side. Lit — safe.

tiles.name: Pump Station
tiles.note: A catwalk ring three metres over a pit of pumps, a stair down at each corner.

tiles.name: The Turbine Hall
tiles.note: The biggest room in the level: galleries run the length of it as catwalks over four turbine sets.

tiles.name: The Boiler House
tiles.note: Four boilers against the back wall with a service gap behind them, steam vents on the stokers' side, fuel stacked by the south wall.

tiles.name: Central Stores
tiles.note: Racking in back-to-back rows with a cross aisle, the loading floor at the south end.

tiles.name: The Machine Shop
tiles.note: Lathes in two rows, presses by the south wall, workbenches and tool cabinets along the north.
A pump room and its switch room one side of a corridor, the transformer room and the valve room the other.
The tool crib, the foreman and a small store north of the corridor; the fitting shop and the chemical store south.
A gallery with its rooms built along it: an office and a switch room north, a tool crib and a valve room south.
The crew's gallery: lockers and toilets north, the mess and the drying room south. The mess is lit.

tiles.name: Generator Hall
tiles.note: Two rows of generators, the switchboard along the north wall, cabinets along the south.

tiles.name: Filter Hall
tiles.note: Horizontal filter tanks in two rows either side of the walkway, steam on their faces.

tiles.name: Tank Farm
tiles.note: Twelve vertical tanks on a grid, fuel stacked by the south wall.

tiles.name: Transformer Yard
tiles.note: Eight transformers on a grid, the breakers along the north wall, cabinets along the south.
